Subject: Security questionnaire: PII tagging and export controls (attached)

Hi Logan,

Thanks for taking this on. Attached is our short SSQ focusing on three areas we need clarified before legal can sign off on the DPA addendum: 1) field-level PII tagging and class mapping, 2) token redaction and ephemeral cache behavior, and 3) cross-border export controls for inference request/response artifacts.

Top asks are:
- Provide the canonical PII classification schema you use internally (fields + tags + examples).
- Confirm whether model responses or hidden artifacts (KV caches, streaming buffers) are persisted and for how long.
- Describe controls preventing export of PII during automated exports/backups and whether we can request geofenced exports.

We attached an annotated dataflow PDF where we've drawn redlines. Please review and return a filled copy or point us to a short doc that maps answers to our questions. If helpful, we can do a 30-min walkthrough early next week.

Attachments: SSQ_Attachment_Annotated_Dataflow_v2.pdf (12 pages), token-redaction-matrix.csv (example mapping)

Best,
Elena
Head of Security, DataControl Inc.

Subject: Re: Security questionnaire: PII tagging and export controls (attached)

Thanks Elena — appreciate the clear asks and the annotated dataflow. Looping in Marissa (privacy ops), Priyom (platform security) and Laura (legal ops) so we can provide a consolidated response.

High-level answers up front:
- PII tagging: we maintain a field-level classification schema (PII categories: direct_id, indirect_id, sensitive, behavioral) stored in our metadata service. We can export the schema as CSV or JSON and will attach the current canonical mapping.
- Ephemeral artifacts: KV caches used for inference are in-memory by default; persisted caches are only created for customer-requested long-tail session storage and require explicit opt-in. Default retention is 0 for persisted caches; where persisted it is configurable per-customer (typical options: 0, 7, 30 days). Streaming buffers are transient and not written to disk.
- Export controls: exports and backups are region-scoped. We support geofenced exports (EU-only) and customer-managed keys for at-rest encryption. Exports to external systems require a signed export request; automated backups to cold storage are stored in region and encrypted with CMKs.

Action plan: Priyom will produce a short technical note and include the dataflow callouts. Marissa will prepare the PII schema export and suggested redaction matrix. Laura, can you do a quick procurement note on the DPA language for geofenced export?

I can do a 30-min walkthrough Tuesday 10/19 9am CET or Wednesday 10/20 11am CET — which works for you?

Thanks,
Logan
Director, Product Security
Redwood Inference

Hi Elena — thanks for the sync this morning. As promised, attaching the follow-ups and owners below.

What we shared in the call (artifacts attached):
- PII schema export (CSV): columns = field_name, example_value, classification_tag (direct_id|indirect_id|sensitive|behavioral), default_transformation (none|hash_sha256|tokenize_pii), storage_scope (transient|persisted_optin).
- Token redaction matrix (CSV): mapping of artifact type -> retention_default -> persisted_location -> transformation_applied.
- Technical note (short): persisted caches are stored in S3 eu-west-1 buckets under customer-specific prefixes; backup to cold archive (NorthernCloud) is encrypted with customerCMK when requested. Access to persisted caches/backups is restricted to infra and on-call SREs via role-based access; subprocessors with direct access: NorthernCloud (storage), RedLogistics (backup transfer) — both listed in our subprocessor roster.
- Geofence enforcement: exports are blocked by a middleware gate in the export pipeline that checks region tag, customer consent flags, and a signed export token. The default is "blocked" for cross-border; manual approvals produce one-time export tokens which are time-bound and logged.

Owners and next steps:

- Priyom Das: finalize the technical note and attach a short list of subprocessors & access controls by 10/19 14:00 CET.

Attachments: SSQ_Attachment_Annotated_Dataflow_v2.pdf (filled), token-redaction-matrix.csv (filled), pii-schema-export.csv
